notes.implicit_borrowing_rate_after_tax: Rate charged on operating liabilities in ROOA and OLSPREAD.

headlines.revenue: Revenue shrank 0.6% a year from FY2022 to FY2026, to $43.1B.
headlines.returns: QCOM earned 44.5% on its operating assets in FY2026; financing adds 8.3 points for shareholders (ROCE 52.8%).

headlines.cash: Free cash flow was 100% of net income over 5 years: profits turn into cash.
